shared.title: How bridges stand up
shared.description: Tension, compression and resonance: a walk through the forces in a bridge, from the Roman arch to the Tacoma Narrows collapse of 1940.

orders.sentences:
S1 [0:00] Welcome back.
S2 [0:03] Today we load a bridge until it breaks.
S3 [0:08] First, the tools.

orders.before: S40 [31:02] And that is why it fell.
orders.sentences:
S41 [31:05] Now, the arch.
S42 [31:09] The Romans had no steel, so every bridge they built is an arch.
